verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents team comments: an @mentioned teammate gains access to the email thread, sees real-time typing indicators, and gets unread-comment highlighting, so a team can share and discuss individual threads. There is no evidence of a true shared inbox or shared account where everyone sees the same conversation state, and community users note it lacks Front-style multi-inbox and team inboxes. Missing for 10: shared/team inbox or shared account access, synchronized shared conversation state (e.g. done/assigned status across teammates), independent hands-on corroboration of team workflows.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state

citations.quote: Something special happens when you `@mention` a teammate in a comment – they suddenly get access to not just your comment, but the email too
Team comments let you privately discuss an email with your team directly in Shortwave, so you can plan how to respond together, and easily keep all the relevant people in the loop.
When other people are commenting, you’ll also see real-time typing indicators, so you can coordinate and avoid stepping on each other’s toes.
